title: The Cipher of the DMZ
author: Jude Eastwick
blurb: Kestrel Iversen, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
